name: Piss Kinksters Against Capitalism!
source:
Piss Kinksters Against Capitalism! is aninteractive fiction game about two gay guys arranging to meet up to do a watersports scene.

This game explores themes of shame, what it means to have a fetish, and the healing power of queer sexuality. 

[Edited from [url=https://xfleshpotx.itch.io/piss-kinksters]itch.io[/url]]
